notes.title: Mask Up 5.0 is now available!
notes.notes:
Hello lovely people,

I just published a new content update for Mask Up. This update adds a new playable form that should settle the "which form is the best" debate.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39749993/55cf68570ed1fb4578b3827d10225eeb6a3e6959.gif[/img]

This new form can only be achieved when filling up the juice bar in human form next to the statue depicted above. I gave it a feminine look, as this form is a counterpart to the "buff form", which was more masculine. In this form, you can shoot juice projectiles that move toward enemies automatically. But be careful, as each shot will cost you a good chunk of juice. If you lose the form, you'll downgrade straight to the slug form. I even made you a chart, because who doesn't love charts:

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39749993/fb5fdc288272404029bd56fb240b756850a56219.png[/img]

Along with the new form, I also added a few bonuses, like a new shop item, but I'll let you check it out for yourself.

[h3]Other changes
[/h3]

I also took some time to improve existing aspects of the game. Here a list of smaller changes I made:

[list]
[*]     Made a lot of masks easier to obtain
[*]     Added controller button icons in tutorial text when a controller is plugged-in
[*]     Added a sound effect when a tutorial is cleared
[*]     Balanced world generation, added a few new rooms
[*]     Increased probability to get weapons in a dark shop
[*]     Improved mobility of form 2 and 3
[*]     Fixed human kick on ground jank
[*]     Fixed phone lock on loading on android, added loading progression display
[*]     Improved camera at high speed
[*]     Other small bug fixes
[/list]

That's right, a big part of the masks are now a lot easier to get. I realized thanks to the achievements stats that many masks have never been unlocked, and this update aims to change that a bit. I hope you'll try it and eventually discover new masks.

Feel free to join the discord server to be notified about future updates:
https://discord.gg/FfrFQ5Yv

Cheers,

Rouli.

notes.title: Mask Up releases in one week!
notes.notes:
Hey Steam folks!

My game Mask Up is releasing in one week! To celebrate, I decided to create this special drawing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39749993/1ba889c3742d2f6bf363aacda4fd96e72b70c8f1.png[/img]

If you're interested in Mask Up, feel free to add the game to your wishlist so that you don't miss out. Thank you for reading!

notes.title: Trailer is here!
notes.notes:
This new trailer gives you a good overview of the game and its different mecanics. Many thanks to PeKaNo for the music. Check it out!

[previewyoutube=IYfAUGXFOeA;full][/previewyoutube]

So what did you all think?

As the game is set to launch in a bit less than a month, I'm doing the final tweaks and adjustements. It gets surprisingly difficult to balance a game with 3 playable forms and that many elements. I hope you're looking forward to playing Mask Up!

If you don't want to miss any news, make sure to join the [url=https://discord.gg/EvzjpVzg2u]discord server[/url]. If you only want to be notified about major milestones, you can also subscribe to the [url=https://t.me/mask_up]Telegram channel[/url].

Thank you for reading!

                Rouli
